create_asset_card: create an AssetCard with a name, metadata mapping, and optional base card for inheritance
get_asset_card_field: get a typed field from an AssetCard using the field method with a field name
check_asset_card_has_field: check if an AssetCard has a specific field using the has_field method
convert_field_to_uri: convert an AssetCardField value to a Uri using the as_uri method for path resolution
load_asset_config: load and merge asset configuration overrides from an AssetCard using StandardAssetConfigLoader
